name: coronary_ffr
description: FFR calculator and 3-element Windkessel closed-form references.

ffr.definition: FFR = Pd / Pa under maximal hyperemia

metrics.name: ffr_classification
metrics.assert: FFR 0.75 ischemic; 0.85 non-ischemic; 0.80 boundary is non-ischemic

notes: Coronary-specific windkessel parameter sets land with the coronary workflow (rfcs/0005 Stage 0 extension).
